topic: The villain who was right all along — and fans only realized it too late
hook: The villain was right. Fans only realized it too late.
script: The villain was right. Fans only realized it too late. Pain from Naruto believed that shared suffering was the only path to peace. His logic was brutal. His methods were horrifying. But his core argument — that the cycle of violence could not end without universal pain — was never truly disproven. The hero defeated him through willpower and speeches. But Pain's world still exists. Follow for anime villains whose philosophy outlived their defeat.
